data.narrative:
Dhruva Space is a Series B-stage space and aerospace company that has raised ₹27 crore to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private companies operating in the same sector and stage band, including Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Aalyria, and Skyryse.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using the ₹27 crore total raised as a proxy baseline and applying a typical 1.9x step-up multiplier for Series B progression, implies a valuation of $51 million. Peer-median analysis across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $1.6 billion, with a range of $1.1 billion (Skyryse) to $8.0 billion (Sierra Space). Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied, as Dhruva Space's revenue is not disclosed. The public Space & Aerospace sector median P/S multiple is 24.4x across six tickers, but remains inapplicable absent revenue data.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $44 million (low) to $1.9 billion (high), with a median of $825 million. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around Dhruva Space's revenue trajectory, operational maturity relative to peers, and which comparable set (early-stage capital-efficiency metrics versus late-stage peer multiples) best reflects its risk-return profile. Stage-progression methods anchor conservatively; peer medians dominate the upside case.
